description: [Paid-only, $0.10 USDC per call: this free MCP tool returns payment instructions, not a result. Get the result from POST https://api.kkuldogu.com/v1/resignation-settlement with x402.] South Korea resignation settlement in one call: statutory severance pay, retirement income tax and local tax, net severance, unused annual-leave pay, and how much more you get by moving the last working day (one more day, week, month, or until the next annual-leave grant). Uses the ordinary wage when it is higher than the average wage. Optionally adds the unemployment benefit estimate for an involuntary separation.

age.description: Age at separation; with insuredYears, adds the unemployment benefit estimate

annualBonus.description: Bonuses paid in the last 12 months (KRW)

fiveOrMoreEmployees.description: Workplace has 5+ employees (annual leave rules apply); default true

monthlyOrdinaryWage.description: Monthly ordinary wage; defaults to monthlyPay (KRW)

monthlyPay.description: Average gross monthly pay for the last 3 months (KRW)

unusedLeaveDays.description: Accrued annual-leave days not yet used; default 0

name: resignation_settlement
